_comment: Copy this file to gsc-indexing-debugger.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your own site's values. Every field is optional — the tool works without this file, just with less site-specific shortcut behavior.
_domain_comment: Bare hostname (no www, no protocol). Used to auto-guess the Search Console siteUrl for Domain properties.
_siteUrl_comment: Explicit Search Console property identifier. Use 'sc-domain:example.com' for a Domain property, or 'https://www.example.com/' for a URL-prefix property. Overrides the domain-based guess when set.
_sitemapIndexPath_comment: Path to your sitemap index, relative to the site origin. Most sites use /sitemap.xml; adjust if yours lives elsewhere (e.g. /sitemaps/sitemap.xml).
_routeFamilies_comment: Optional list of known URL-prefix route families (e.g. ['blog', 'docs', 'products']) for smarter sitemap/export clustering in check-sitemap.cjs and parse-gsc-export.cjs. Leave empty to always full-scan/generic-bucket instead — this is safe, just less targeted.
